summary.text: Robert Erbele is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 28 (Lehr), serving since 2001. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Appropriations, where he is vice chair.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Erbele is a semi-retired rancher who studied agricultural economics, animal science and music at NDSU.

His biography lists a Legislator of the Year award from ND Township Officers and a Public Service Award from the ND Veterinary Medical Association, and service as lay leader of the Lehr Community Church.
He chairs the Memorial Resolutions committee and in the interim serves on the Agriculture and Water Management Committee and the Higher Education Institutions Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Susan, with four children.
